annotations.text:
Three directions for ekaterine dadiani's site, same real content in each (copy from the CV and the papers).

Pick one and the full site gets built in it: home, research pages with the dual AGN explorer embedded, publications and talks, CV page with the auto-built PDF, mobile layouts.

Links are placeholders here. [DATE] fills in from the CV build.

A · Preprint
Light, warm off-white, serif display (Newsreader) with Plex Sans and Mono. One crimson accent lifted from the DESI figure.

Why: figures come out of matplotlib on white, so they sit naturally; sections read like a well-typeset paper. Ages well.
Tradeoff: the quietest of the three; the dark explorer embeds as a framed window.

B · Observatory
Dark cool near-black, warm white type, amber accent taken from the COSMOS-Web markers. Bricolage Grotesque display, Instrument Sans body.

Why: seamless with the dual AGN explorer's dark theme; the strongest first impression.
Tradeoff: white-background figures need framing or dark re-exports; heavier to keep consistent.

C · Field notes
Neutral grey, wide Archivo display in caps, Space Mono labels, a single blue. Strict 12-column grid with rules.

Why: data-forward; publications as a table, projects as tiles; scales cleanly as the list grows.
Tradeoff: the least personal and the coolest in tone.
